name: PyInstaller macOS Build

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: macos-14

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.9'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        pip install pyinstaller pyobjc-core

    - name: Convert icon.png to .icns
      run: |
        sips -s format icns icon.png --out icon.icns

    - name: Create PyInstaller spec file
      run: |
        cat <<EOF > obi-macos.spec

strip = True
upx = True
console = False
debug = False
loglevel = INFO
onefile = False
windowed = False
noconfirm = False
noupx = False
upx_exclude = []

[EXE]
type = EXECUTABLE

target_arch = x86_64
target_platform = darwin
target_binary_format = macho

name: PyInstaller macOS Build

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: macos-14

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.9'
